Youth Against Kurakot led the Halloween protest today at the People Power Monument, joined by hundreds of young Filipinos dressed in Halloween costumes to condemn the rampant corruption in the Philippines and to call upon the government to “exorcise” the monsters of corruption within it. Akbayan Rep. Chel Diokno and Rep. Perci Cendaña also joined the Halloween protest.

Youth Against Kurakot Lead Convenor and Akbayan Youth Secretary General Khylla Meneses emphasized that this Halloween creative action is intended to expose the horrors of corruption: “Walang pinagkaiba ang mga kurap sa mga aswang sa kwentong bayan. Pareho silang nagtatago sa kadiliman, at naghihintay ng pagkakataon na mapagsamantalahan ang taumbayan.” 

Meneses, however, reminded that the Filipino people should be angry and not scared of the horrors of corruption: 

“The horrors of corruption should not scare us. Lalakas ang pwersa ng kadiliman kung maniniwala tayong wala tayong laban. Ipakita natin sa kanila na tayo ang may kapangyarihan at di tayo titigil hanggat hindi naipapakulong ang lahat ng mga halimaw sa pamahalaan.”

In connection with the installation of a Foot Over Bridge in front of Siraspur Gurudwara, NH-44

📍 Affected Roads/Diversions: Both carriageways(NH-44 from T-Point Sanjay Gandhi Transport Nagar to Khatu Shyam Mandir near Alipur Village and vice versa). 
📍 Timing: 11:00 PM – 04:00 AM on 25/26 & 26/27.10.2025
📍 Alternate Routes: Use NH-44 service roads from Sanjay Gandhi Transport Nagar towards Alipur and Khatu Shyam Mandir towards Mukarba Chowk.
📍 Advisory: Plan your journey, avoid affected stretch, prefer public transport and follow traffic personnel instructions.
